<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>CallAck</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"post"} path={"/"}></MethodEndpoint>


This API sends a delivered receipt for an offline call invitation on behalf of a user.

After the user accepts the invitation and enters the call, other users in the call will receive a notification of the call user status change through the following ZIM SDK callback:

| iOS-25% | Android-25% | macOS-25% | Windows-25% |
|----|----|----|----|
| [callUserStateChanged](/zim-ios/client-sdks/api-reference/protocol#zimcalluserstatechangedcallid-zimeventhandler) | [onCallUserStateChanged](/zim-android/client-sdks/api-reference/class#oncalluserstatechanged-zimeventhandler) | [callUserStateChanged](/zim-macos/client-sdks/api-reference/protocol#zimcalluserstatechangedcallid-zimeventhandler) | [onCallUserStateChanged](/zim-win/client-sdks/api-reference/class#oncalluserstatechanged-zimeventhandler) |

| Web-25% | Flutter-25% | React Native-25% | Unity3D-25% |
|----|----|----|----|
| [onCallUserStateChanged](/zim-web/client-sdks/api-reference/class#oncalluserstatechanged-zimeventhandler) | [onCallUserStateChanged](/zim-flutter/client-sdks/api-reference/class#oncalluserstatechanged-zimeventhandler) | [onCallUserStateChanged](/zim-rn/client-sdks/api-reference/class#oncalluserstatechanged-zimeventhandler) | [OnCallUserStateChanged](/zim-u3d/client-sdks/api-reference/class#oncalluserstatechanged-zimeventhandler) |

<Note title="QPS Limit">20 requests/s</Note>
